title: Replay rounds: each training round brings back a share of every earlier round
request: The owner: do 36.5, so a model trained in rounds does not forget what earlier rounds taught it.
spec: PHASE12_TRAINING_DATA_PLAN.md 36.5: each round's set is its new data plus a fixed share of every earlier round, stratified by model type, source, track and language; its manifest names every earlier version; nothing is deleted; a round rebuilt from its manifest is byte-identical and the share holds per stratum.
plan: Read how the store writes its sets
Contract and the draw rule in dclab_core
Test first, then the store side
Plan on the real store; prove rebuilds on a copy

decisions.why: a round is one training run's data; no model is trained yet, so building one would mark data as trained
a stratum of one row, such as a rare Persian conversation, still comes back

decisions.decision: Keep each round's new rows frozen and draw replay from them
decisions.why: a rebuild then reads only the rounds' own files, never the sets that move on

decisions.decision: A row is its set and its id
decisions.why: the same id sits in two real m4 sets with different content; keying by id alone lost 22 rows

decisions.decision: Only rows still allowed in training come back
decisions.why: a row withdrawn by consent, curation or an exam must not return through an old round

change: dclab_core/replay.py (ReplayRound v1, pick; dclab-core 0.136.0, schemas, adapter entry), dclab_rnd/store/replay.py, store/layout.py rounds(), CORE_INTEGRATION.md, PHASE12 status, data catalog, tests/test_store_replay.py.

findings.defect: A corrected row came back in its old form from round three on
findings.scenario: rows wrong in round one, fixed in round two; round three replayed the wrong copies
findings.cause: every earlier round's copy of a row stayed in the pool, and the first one drawn won
findings.fix: each row comes back only from the latest round holding it; every drawn row is written and counted

findings.defect: A row no longer allowed in training could come back
findings.scenario: consent withdrawn, a curator's out, or a row that joined an exam, still replayed from an old round
findings.cause: replay read the earlier rounds without asking what is allowed now
findings.fix: only rows still in the current train split and outside every exam come back; the others are written as withheld

findings.defect: The same id in two sets lost one of its rows
findings.scenario: real m4: 18 ids in two sets with different content; 22 lines never entered a round
findings.cause: rows were keyed by id alone
findings.fix: a row is its set and its id

findings.defect: A missing or swapped earlier round was read silently
findings.scenario: round one deleted: its rows counted as new again
findings.cause: rounds were not required to run without a gap, and a draw did not name the earlier round's hash
findings.fix: rounds must run without a gap; each draw records the earlier round's hash and a rebuild checks it

findings.defect: A rebuild depended on today's code
findings.scenario: a change to how language or track is read would move every old draw
findings.cause: strata were read again from each row at rebuild
findings.fix: each row's stratum is frozen in the round when it is first kept

findings.defect: A build that stopped half way blocked every later build
findings.scenario: a round folder without its manifest made every plan fail
findings.cause: files were written straight into the round's folder
findings.fix: a build writes to a part folder and renames it when whole; a leftover part folder is named in the error

findings.defect: One real row was cut in two
findings.scenario: an m5 row holds a Unicode line separator inside its text
findings.cause: splitting lines on every kind of line break
findings.fix: JSON lines split on newlines only

findings.defect: Kept rows carried an extra field
findings.scenario: a trainer checking rows against their contract would refuse them
findings.cause: the set name was written into each row
findings.fix: each row is kept exactly as its set wrote it, with its set beside it

measurements.name: replay rounds on a copy of the real store (m2, m4, m5)
measurements.gate: a round rebuilt from its files is byte-identical; the replay share holds per stratum
measurements.result: three rounds each for m2, m4 and m5 rebuilt byte-identical; the replayed share 30.1 to 30.6 percent; no stratum off by a whole row; a round's train equals its new plus its drawn rows
measurements.against_gate: every rebuild identical and every stratum within one row of its share
limits: a copy of the sets of three model types, with no new data between rounds
no real round is built until a model is trained

outcome: Each training round can now bring back a share of every earlier round, stratum by stratum, and be rebuilt exactly; a row corrected, withdrawn or moved into an exam never comes back in an old form.
lessons: Key a row by where it lives and its id, not its id alone.
Anything replayed from the past must be checked against what is allowed now.
Freeze every input a rebuild needs inside the thing being rebuilt.
JSON lines split on newlines only.
risks: Decision rows have no track or language, so their strata are only their sets.
The share and the strata are untested on a real second round with new data.
